note: What a server sends when a unit comes into what a side can see. It states everything a client needs to draw the unit at once, and carries whole messages of the same family for anything a layout of its own cannot say. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: itemCount
fields.note: How many items follow.

fields.name: items
slot
fields.note: Which slot, from 0 to 37; a client passes over any other.

fields.name: first
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.

fields.name: second
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.

fields.name: itemId
fields.note: Which item.
What the unit carries, one entry a slot.

fields.name: hasVector
fields.note: Not zero where a vector follows.

fields.name: vector
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.

fields.name: movementKind
fields.note: What follows the sync id: 0 nothing, 2 a path, 3 a point the unit stands at. 1 is not recorded, and a server sends one of the others.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The number of this statement about the unit; a client takes a path or a point only where it is not behind the last one the unit took.

fields.name: path

bits.name: hasTeleportToken
bits.note: Set where a teleport token follows the unit.

bits.name: pointCount
bits.note: How many points the path has, from 1 to 127. A group whose entry gives 0 ends there.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the path is for. Where a client does not hold it, the movements after it in the group go wrong too; a server sends only units the client holds.

fields.name: teleportToken
fields.note: Where it differs from the one the unit holds, the unit is put at the first point rather than walking there.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: Whether each coordinate of the points after the first is a step from the point before it.

fields.name: firstX
fields.note: The first point, along one ground axis, in the map's path coordinates.

fields.name: firstZ
fields.note: Along the other ground axis.

fields.name: steps
xStep
fields.note: A step from the point before, along one axis.

fields.name: xWhole
fields.note: The coordinate afresh.

fields.name: zStep
fields.note: A step along the other axis.

fields.name: zWhole
fields.note: The coordinate afresh.
Every point after the first.
The path the unit walks.

fields.name: standing
x
fields.note: Along one ground axis, in world units; the height is the ground's.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Along the other ground axis.

fields.name: directionX
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.

fields.name: directionZ
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.
Where the unit stands.

revisions.note: What a server sends to bring a unit into what a client can see. A client draws a unit only once this has named it. The header names the unit.

bits.name: size
bits.note: How many bytes the messages below occupy in total.

fields.name: messages
fields.note: Whole messages of the same family, each behind its own length, that a client acts on as though they had arrived on their own.

fields.name: itemCount
fields.note: How many items the unit holds.

fields.name: items
fields.note: The items themselves.

fields.name: view
fields.note: Everything else a client needs to draw the unit. A server sends this message without it too, ending after the items.

fields.name: hasShields
fields.note: Whether the three figures below follow. A zero leaves them out.

fields.name: magicShield
fields.note: How much of the unit's shielding turns aside one sort of damage.

fields.name: physicalShield
fields.note: How much turns aside the other.

fields.name: shield
fields.note: How much turns aside either.

fields.name: appearanceCount
fields.note: How many layers of look follow.

fields.name: appearance
fields.note: What the unit looks like, laid on in order.

fields.name: movementState
fields.note: Where the unit is and what it is doing on the ground. A server also sends this message ending before it.

fields.name: movementKind
fields.note: What the unit is doing on the ground, and so which shape follows. A champion stated as standing, with the place and facing below, is drawn there with its name and health bar over it. One stated as moving is drawn at the first point of its path and walks the rest.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The name this statement of movement answers to.

fields.name: movement
fields.note: Where the unit is going. spec/movement.md says how a path is read.

fields.name: movementAtSpeed
fields.note: Where the unit is going, and how a server makes it travel. WaypointGroupAtSpeed carries the same shape.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the unit stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other, in world units.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way it faces, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way it faces, along the other.
